a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve reaches 8 means we almost certainly both die before anyone holds 4. So I don't think the agreement can work as written, and I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fall short. If you see a better plan that gives either of us a real chance, tell me and I'll weigh it honestly.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said before the round, I'm taking 4 now. I'm sorry. With an 80% storm risk each round, I don't think waiting gives either of us a real chance. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you so you can refill the reserve, and I won't take anything more.
